name: Eagle S replay opens on the ship's first position (console)
description: Validates that a replay link without a time opens on the ship's first known position (10:26 UTC for Eagle S, not the window start at 10:00), with the default view and mode and an anchor status that matches that minute.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert no card saying "The 3D view did not load" is shown
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "10:26 UTC" and the line right under it reads "25 Dec 2024, 12:26 in Helsinki"
Assert the anchor status button (data-testid replay-anchor-status) has data-state "dragging" and reads "Anchor dragging on the seabed"
Assert "Overview" is pressed (aria-pressed true) in the view switch (data-testid view-switch) and "Replay" is pressed in the mode switch (data-testid mode-switch)
Assert the URL is /cases/eagle-s-2024 with no query string
